Overview

  • Issuing authority: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC)
  • Notification: ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 (notification ID not specified)
  • Total vacancies: 3,047 apprentice posts across Graduate, Technician (Diploma), and Trade categories
  • Application window: 29 October 2026 to 20 November 2026 (as reported by Jagran Josh)
  • Official website: ongcindia.com
  • Source: Jagran Josh article dated 2026 reporting on ONGC's official notification

Eligibility Criteria

*All criteria per ONGC notification as reported by Jagran Josh.*

Nationality

  • Must be an Indian citizen.

Educational Qualifications

  • Graduate Apprentice: Bachelor's degree (BA, B.Com, B.Sc, BBA, BE, or B.Tech) in relevant discipline from a recognised university or institute.
  • Technician (Diploma) Apprentice: Diploma in relevant engineering trade from a recognised board or institute.
  • Trade Apprentice: Full-time ITI certificate (NCVT/GCVT) or Class 12 pass, depending on the specific trade.

Age Limit

  • Minimum age: 18 years (as on cut-off date not specified in source).
  • Age relaxation for reserved categories as per government rules.

Other Conditions

  • Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship training or are currently undergoing it are generally not eligible.

Application Process

*Steps summarised from Jagran Josh's guide; always verify on the official portal.*

  • Visit ongcindia.com.
  • Navigate to the Careers section and click the apprentice recruitment link.
  • Read the ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 notification carefully.
  • Register with name, mobile number, and email ID if required.
  • Log in and fill personal, educational, and trade details.
  • Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required documents in prescribed format.
  • Review details and submit the form.
  • Download and print the confirmation page for future reference.
